scope: Italian AI / automation employers; read-only employer research. Parent selected noze for main batch; MANDARINO and Skienda are backups.

dedup.method: Case-insensitive company, email/domain and relevant parent-company name search across every recursively found *applications*.csv, loop/outreach*.csv, and sent-history.json

companies.verified_services: LLM integration, local/cloud RAG, agentic and multi-agent systems, MCP, integration into existing systems and workflows.

companies.candidate_fit: Applied LLM/API workflow delivery, RAG support tools and automation, plus real FlowSpace product migration from Bubble into React/TypeScript and Laravel. Pitch integration/full-stack contributor work rather than ML research, Rust SDK or cybersecurity expertise.
companies.personalization: Connect FlowSpace automation and production API integrations to noze's approach of adding AI to existing systems. Include a real built-project or portfolio link because the careers page specifically requests it.
companies.uncertainties: No currently guaranteed vacancy, compensation or contract type. n8n is not named on the verified noze pages. Do not claim candidate is a Rust/security/ML specialist.
